STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE

MOVE & FIGHT

WASDDrive the tank
MOUSEAim the turret
CLICKSPACEFire main gun
ESpecial ability
RRepair (stand still)
MEnlarge minimap (Skirmish)
ESCPause / resume

Your turret always follows the mouse, so you can drive one way and shoot another. Keep moving: a stationary tank is an easy target.

YOUR TANK

    Light tanks are fast but fragile. Medium tanks balance both. Heavies are slow and hit hard. Specialist tanks trade their normal ability for a powerful weapon.

    ARMOUR

    FRONTstrongest, often ricochets
    SIDEnormal damage
    REARweakest, takes extra
    • FLANK THEM. Shots to the rear do far more damage than shots to the front. Keep your front facing the enemy.
    • RICOCHETS. Shells can bounce off thick front armour and do nothing. Look for the RICOCHET! tag.
    • COMPONENTS. Hits can damage the engine (speed), tracks (movement), turret (aiming, briefly locked) and gun (jams). Press R while stationary to repair.
    • FEEDBACK. Numbers pop up on every hit. Yellow = heavy hit, red = you took damage. The red arrow around your tank points at who hit you.
    • SMOKE. Tanks inside smoke cannot be targeted. Use it to escape or to reposition.
    • STREAKS. Chain kills for DOUBLE KILL, KILLING SPREE, RAMPAGE and more.

    GAME MODES

    • SKIRMISH. Destroy every enemy tank on a big scrolling map. Use the minimap to find them. Kill the last one for a slow-motion finish.
    • POINT CONTROL. You and four allied tanks fight over three control points (A, B and C). Hold points to build your score. Destroyed tanks respawn after a short delay.
    • CAMPAIGN. The D-Day landing. Complete the mission objectives with allied support. Drive to the repair station to fix your tank.

    Garage and skins are in the main menu. Your progress is saved in this browser.
